It’s the perfect choice for anyone looking to enjoy nicotine in a new, flavourful way.

Killa Cola is perfect for individuals who love cola flavour and need a nicotine product that delivers both taste and a strong kick. Its discreet design makes it easy to carry wherever you go—whether at work, out with friends, or relaxing at home. The classic cola flavour offers a refreshing alternative to traditional tobacco products, helping manage nicotine cravings as you reduce or quit smoking.
